cultural_references: The song 'House Tour' by pop singer Sabrina Carpenter is used as the soundtrack.
central_claim: Donald Trump is personally funding the construction of a beautiful building in Washington D.C. as a gift to the nation, ensuring taxpayers do not have to pay for it.
intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump as a generous benefactor and effective leader who is personally investing in the country, likely to generate admiration and support.
